model

(noun). mô hình

ex: The developer plans to build a model community on the site.

Elegant

(adjective). Quý phái

ex: she's an elegant woman

label

(noun). Nhãn dán

ex: Remember to put some address labels on the suitcases.

garment

(noun). Trang phục

ex: He’s fussy about how a garment fits him.

fabric

(noun). Chất liệu vải

ex: Linen is a coarse-grained fabric.

regard

(verb). Đánh giá

ex: Environmentalists regard GM technology with suspicion.

acceptable

(adjective). chấp nhận được

ex: So what is an acceptable level of radiation?

tailor

(noun). Thợ may

ex: Kings and queens who wear a suit but once, though made by some tailor or dressmaker to their majesties, cannot know the comfort of wearing a suit that fits.

rupee

(noun). đồng bạc ấn độ

ex: Cremation was impossible because the money needed for wood for the funeral pyre, 300 to 400 rupees, was lacking.

bargain

(noun). Món hời

ex: This coat was half-price - a real bargain.

material

(noun). Chất liệu

ex: Crude oil is used as the raw (= basic) material for making plastics.

polyester

(noun). Vải pôliexte (vải nhân tạo dùng để may quần áo)

ex: She's wearing a polyester shirt

acceptance

(noun). sự đồng tình

ex: The party marked his acceptance into the community.

innovative

(adjective). Mang tính sáng tạo

ex: She was an imaginative and innovative manager.

plastic

(noun). nhựa dẻo

ex: He put a sheet of plastic over the broken window.

coat

(verb). phủ

ex: When the biscuits are cool, you coat them in/with melted chocolate.

Overseas

(adverb). từ nước ngoài

ex: My brother is a student overseas.

decade

(noun). Thập kỉ

ex: Air traffic has increased 30% in the last decade.

witness

(verb). chứng kiến

ex: Did anyone witness the attack?

export

(verb). Xuất khẩu

ex: French cheeses are exported to many different countries.

contour

(noun). đường nét

ex: He studied the contours of her face.

masculine

(adjective). có dáng dấp đàn ông

ex: His features were masculine and strong.

showy

(adjective). lòe loẹt

ex: Her dress was too showy for such a formal occasion.

associate

(adjective). phó

ex: You have to speak to associate judges

millennium

(noun). thiên niên kỷ

ex: The corpse had lain preserved in the soil for almost two millennia.

shrink

(verb). Thu nhỏ

ex: Your sweater will shrink if you wash it at too high a temperature.

ethnic

(adjective). tính dân tộc

ex: A question on ethnic origin was included in the census.

key

(adjective). bí quyết; giải pháp

ex: She was a key figure in the international art world.

element

(noun). Yếu tố

ex: List the elements that make up a perfect dinner party.

fashion

(noun). thời trang

ex: Long hair is back in fashion for men.

industry

(noun). công nghiệp

ex: The strike seriously reduced coal deliveries to industry.

sensible

(adjective). biết điều, hợp lý

ex: I think the sensible thing to do is call and ask for directions.

accelerate

(verb). gia tốc

ex: I accelerated to overtake the bus.

cotton

(noun). Chất liệu cô-tông

ex: She looked pretty in a simple cotton dress.

producer

(noun). nhà sản xuất

ex: The producer disliked the script and demanded a rewrite.

silk

(noun). tơ tằm

ex: I've been lusting after one of their silk shirts for ages.

fibre

(noun). Vải sợi; Chất xơ

ex: The fibres are woven into fabric.

manufacture

(verb). Sản xuất

ex: He works for a company that manufactures car parts.

clothing

(noun). y phục

ex: Protective clothing must be worn.

fundamental

(adjective). Căn bản, cốt lõi

ex: It's one of the fundamental differences between men and women.

workforce

(noun). Lực lượng lao động

ex: Much of the workforce in the banking sector is/are affected by the new legislation.

cost-effective

(adjective). tiết kiệm chi phí

ex: It wouldn't be cost-effective to buy an expensive new computer when all you want to do is store your photos.

raw

(adjective). còn sống

ex: Helen made a grimace of disgust when she saw the raw meat.

flexibility

(noun). Tính linh hoạt

ex: The advantage of this system is its flexibility.

sequin

(noun). đồ trang sức hình đồng tiền

ex: Her dress sparkled with sequins.

beadwork

(noun). đồ trang trí hạt

ex: her skins are decorated with paint and beadword

embroidery

(noun). sự thêu

ex: my mother decided I should learn embroidery

currency

(noun). tiền tệ

ex: the dollar was a strong currency

depress

(verb). chán nản

ex: that first day at school depressed me

thereby

(adverb). do thế

modern

(adjective). Hiện đại

ex: it was a nice modern house

machinery

(noun). Máy móc

ex: it's a piece of machinery

account for

(verb). giải thích cho

belie

(verb). gây ấn tượng sai lầm

ex: Her calm face belied the terror she was feeling.

churn out

(verb). Sản xuất cái gì với số lượng lớn mà không quan tâm tới chất lượng.

ex: Hollywood studios have been churning out some very bad movies over the past several years.

crude

(adjective). Thô

ex: The constructed a crude shelter from branches.

craftwork

(noun). Đồ thủ công mỹ nghệ

ex: club activities include craftwork and exercise classes

internationally

(adverb). quốc tế

ex: They are planning to expand the business internationally.

humble

(adjective). khiêm tốn

ex: He's very humble about his success.

origin

(noun). Nguồn gốc

ex: It's a book about the origin of the universe.

adopt

(verb). Thông qua, lựa chọn

ex: They've adopted a baby girl.

utilize

(verb). Tận dụng

ex: The vitamins come in a form that is easily utilized by the body.

universal

(adjective). Phổ cập khắp nơi

ex: Food, like sex, is a subject of almost universal interest.

lungi

(noun). Khăn quấn (quanh đầu, người)

ex: They do marriages among their community and their attire consists of a shirt and lungi.

bandanna

(noun). Khăn rằn, khăn tay lớn in hoa sặc sỡ

ex: He wears a bandanna over his face until near the end of the clip.

blouse

(noun). áo cánh

ex: he wears a white silk blouse

furnishing

(noun). sự cung cấp, trang bị đồ đạc

ex: Bathroom furnishings are in the basement of the store.

batik

(noun). nhuộm màu

ex: The father could deposit his capital with a bank or merchant batik at an agreed special rate of interest.

embroidered

(adjective). thêu

ex: She stared at the embroidered tablecloth

motif

(noun). mô típ

ex: We chose some curtains with a flower motif.

stylish

(adjective). có phong cách

ex: The film's direction is subtle and stylish.

graceful

(adjective). duyên dáng

ex: The trees, slender and graceful, swayed gently above us.

mischievousness

(noun). tinh quái

ex: He has a childish, boyish, impish mischievousness.

restriction

(noun). hạn chế

ex: The president urged other countries to lift the trade restrictions.

disco

(noun). Vũ trường

ex: Several parents acted as chaperones for the school disco.

pad

(noun). miếng ghép

ex: Soccer players often wear shin pads to protect their legs.

hefty

(adjective). vạm vỡ

ex: Her salary will go up by a hefty 13 percent.

consumer

(noun). Người tiêu dùng

ex: The new rates will affect all consumers, including businesses.

theme

(noun). chủ đề

ex: The theme of loss runs through most of his novels.

coverage

(noun). độ bao phủ

ex: What did you think of the BBC's election coverage?

inevitable

(adjective). Không thể tránh khỏi

ex: The accident was the inevitable consequence/result/outcome of carelessness

downward

(adjective). Theo hướng đi xuống

ex: The country's economy is on a downward spiral.

monopoly

(noun). Sự độc quyền

ex: Is Microsoft a monopoly?

jacquard

(noun). vải dệt hoa

ex: The elegance and comfort of jacquard makes you feel extra-glamorous

crepe

(noun). nhiểu

ex: He's wearing a crepe jacket

georgette

(noun). vải kếp

ex: Chiffon is smoother and more lustrous than the similar fabric georgette.

moss

(noun). rêu

ex: The rocks near the river were covered with moss.

sections.title: Passage 2: Sustainable growth at Didcot The outline of a report by South Oxfordshire District Council
sections.html:
reference

(noun). Dẫn chứng; Tài liệu tham khảo

ex: he made reference to the enormous power of the mass media

council

(noun). Hội đồng

ex: a ban on school buses using the road was imposed by the county council

report

(verb). báo cáo

ex: I'm pleased to report that the matter is now settled

organize

(verb). tổ chức

ex: I organize lessons in a planned way

Sustainable

(adjective). Có thể duy trì lâu dài; Thân thiện với môi trường

ex: sustainable definitions of good educational practice

seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

ex: they came here to seek shelter from biting winter winds

holistic

(adjective). toàn diện

ex: My doctor takes a holistic approach to disease.

urban

(adjective). Thuộc về khu vực thành thị

ex: The council is committed to a programme of urban regeneration.

structure

(verb). cấu tạo

ex: We must carefully structure and rehearse each scene.

individual

(noun). Cá nhân

ex: Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.

component

(noun). Thành phầ

ex: The factory supplies electrical components for cars.

housing

(noun). Vấn đề nhà cửa, chỗ ở

ex: There's a shortage of cheap housing in the region.

inhabitant

(noun). Cư dân

ex: The city of Ely has about 10,000 inhabitants.

isolate

(verb). Cô lập

ex: A high wall isolated the house from the rest of the village.

bisect

(verb). chia đôi

ex: The new road will bisect the town.

railway

(noun). đường sắt

ex: We live close to the railway line.

extension

(noun). Phần mở rộng, kéo dài thêm

ex: The extension (= increasing) of police powers in the province has been heavily criticized.

investment

(noun). sự đầu tư

ex: The government wanted an inflow of foreign investment.

finance

(noun). Tài chính

ex: You need to speak to someone in the finance department.

proportion

(noun). Tỷ lệ

ex: Children make up a large proportion of the world's population.

infrastructure

(noun). Cấu trúc hạ tầng

ex: The war has badly damaged the country's infrastructure.

project

(noun). dự án

ex: My next project is decorating the kitchen.

identification

(noun). sự nhận diện

ex: Please see to it that no-one comes in without identification.

major

(adjective). Quan trọng, tầm cỡ

ex: All of her major plays have been translated into English.

industry

(noun). công nghiệp

ex: The city needs to attract more industry.

military

(adjective). thuộc về quân sự

ex: The minister argued against making cuts in military spending.

ordnance

(noun). vũ khí

ex: the gun was a brand new piece of ordnance

depot

(noun). kho chứa

ex: He took a job in the supply depot of a San Francisco shipyard.

spur

(noun). Móc sắt

ex: the team's win on Saturday would be a spur to even greater effort this season.

expansion

(noun). Sự mở rộng

ex: We need a dynamic expansion of trade with other countries.

consult

(verb). Tham khảo ý kiến

ex: If the symptoms get worse, consult your doctor.

programme

(noun). Danh mục chương trình

ex: It's my favourite TV programme - I never miss an episode.

discussion

(noun). sự bàn luận

ex: The matter is still under discussion (= being considered).

aspiration

(noun). Khát vọng

ex: I've never had any political aspirations.

stakeholder

(noun). cổ đông, các bên liên đới

ex: The bill faces opposition from a number of key stakeholders

undertake

(verb). đảm đương

ex: Students are required to undertake simple experiments.

strategic

(adjective). Mang tính chiến lược

ex: There are plans to modernize the US strategic forces.

master plan

(noun). Quy hoạch tổng thể

ex: America's master plan for peace receives criticism

previously

(adverb). trước đó

ex: they discovered a previously unknown gene

sector

(noun). khu vực

ex: Salaries in the public sector are expected to fall by 15% this year.

superstore

(noun). siêu thị

ex: she has a DIY superstore

parallel

(noun). tương đồng, tương tự

ex: I'm trying to see if there are any obvious parallels between the two cases.

compact

(adjective). gọn nhẹ

ex: What a compact office! How did you fit so much into so little space?

strip

(noun). Mảnh (vải..), dải (đất..)

ex: t rapidly absorbs the elements of water wherever possible, so that a strip of paper plunged into the gas is rapidly charred.

hem

(verb). may lại quần áo

ex: I need to hem those curtains.

density

(noun). Độ dày đặc

ex: The area has a high/low population density.

trade

(noun). Thương mại

ex: 70 percent of the country's trade is with Europe.

spark

(verb). phóng điện

ex: The recent interest-rate rises have sparked new problems for small businesses.

adequate

(adjective). Cân xứng, đầy đủ

ex: Have we got adequate food for 20 guests?

facility

(noun). Cơ sở vật chất

ex: The training facility is scheduled to open in April 2005.

substantial

(adjective). Đáng kể

ex: She inherited a substantial fortune from her grandmother.

outskirt

(noun). vùng ven, ngoại ô

ex: The factory is in/on the outskirts of New Delhi.

secure

(verb). đảm bảo

ex: He was disappointed by his failure to secure the top job with the bank.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

ex: The role of the police is to ensure (that) the law is obeyed.

evaluate

(verb). Đánh giá

ex: We shall need to evaluate how the new material stands up to wear and tear.

growth

(noun). Sự tăng trưởng

ex: A balanced diet is essential for healthy growth.

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng

ex: A problem with evoked potentials is that their amplitude is exceedingly small.

standard

(noun). tiêu chuẩn

ex: This essay is not of an acceptable standard - do it again.

designate

(verb). Chỉ định

ex: Traditionally, the president designates his or her successor.

greenfield

(noun). vùng chưa phát triển

ex: it's a greenfield site

compromise

(noun). thỏa hiệp

ex: It is hoped that a compromise will be reached in today's talks.

legacy

(noun). di sản

ex: An elderly cousin had left her a small legacy.

deficit

(noun). khoảng tiền nhỏ, sự thâm hụt

ex: The UK's deficit in manufactured goods fell slightly in the last three months.

establishment

(noun). thiết lập

ex: it's an educational/financial/religious establishment

afield

(adverb). xa

ex: Our students come from Europe, Asia, and even further afield.

unachievable

(adjective). khó thực hiện được

ex: Engineering limitations rendered the goal unachievable.

authority

(noun). Người có thẩm quyền

ex: He has no authority over (= ability to control) his students

prioritize

(verb). Ưu tiên

ex: You must learn to prioritize your work.

scarce

(adjective). hiếm

ex: Food and clean water were becoming scarce.

requirement

(noun). yêu cầu

ex: choose the type of window that suits your requirements best

basis

(noun). Nền tảng

ex: on the basis of these statistics important decisions are made

sections.title: Passage 3: Language diversity
sections.html:
decade

(noun). Thập kỉ

ex: Air traffic has increased 30% in the last decade.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; Học thuyết

ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

dominant

(adjective). ưu thế

ex: Unemployment will be a dominant issue at the next election.

propose

(verb). đề nghị

ex: He proposed dealing directly with the suppliers.

linguist

(noun). nhà ngôn ngữ học

ex: she's a gifted linguist

universal

(adjective). Phổ cập khắp nơi

ex: the incidents caused universal concern

exception

(noun). Ngoại lệ

ex: the drives between towns are a delight, and the journey to Graz is no exception

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

ex: the financial aspect can be overstressed

controversially

(adverb). một cách gây tranh cãi

ex: the horse was controversially disqualified from first place

indigenous

(adjective). bản địa

ex: The most indigenous inhabitants were the American Indians

distinct

(adjective). Riêng biệt

ex: the gallery is divided into five distinct spaces

indisputable

(adjective). không thể chối cãi

ex: it's a far from indisputable fact

diverse

(adjective). Đa dạng

ex: pupils do activities as diverse as riding and yoga

implication

(noun). Hàm ý

ex: the implication is that no one person at the bank is responsible

race

(noun). cuộc đua

ex: I won the first 50-lap race

disturbing

(adjective). gây phiền

ex: they're disturbing unemployment figures

extinct

(adjective). tuyệt chủng

ex: this species has become extinct

humanity

(noun). nhân loại

ex: there're appalling crimes against humanity

diversity

(noun). Sự đa dạng

ex: there was considerable diversity in the style of the reports

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

ex: how am I going to exist without you?

physical

(adjective). Thuộc về mặt vật lý, cơ thể

ex: a woman's character is much more important than her physical appearance

structure

(noun). Cấu trúc

ex: the courses lack proper structure

outweigh

(verb). đo ván, vượt qua

ex: the advantages greatly outweigh the disadvantages

feature

(noun). đặc tính

ex: safety features like dual air bags are important

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

ex: government regulations can influence behavior

characteristic

(noun). Bản chất; Đặc trưng

ex: large farms are characteristic of this area

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

ex: the situation is more complex than it appears

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

ex: she worked fast, conscious of the time factor

genetics

(noun). di truyền học

ex: Dr. Washington is a specialist in genetics.

independently

(adverb). độc lập

ex: the independently run museum receives no public funding

tendency

(noun). Khuynh hướng

ex: for students, there is a tendency to socialize in the evenings

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng

ex: it became apparent that he was talented

similarity

(noun). sự giống nhau

ex: the similarity of symptoms makes them hard to diagnose

faulty

(noun). có lỗi

ex: her character was faulty

analysis

(noun). phân tích

ex: they carried out a detailed analysis of the evidence

perception

(noun). Nhận thức

ex: When sight in one eye is affected, it can affect our depth perception.

descriptive

(adjective). có tính miêu tả chi tiết

ex: the text contains some good descriptive passages

system

(noun). hệ thống

ex: Our company introduced a new type of heating system

element

(noun). Yếu tố

ex: the death had all the elements of a great tabloid story

reasoning

(noun). sự lập luận, lý lẽ

ex: he questioned the reasoning behind the decision

perceive

(verb). nhận thức

ex: his mouth fell open as he perceived the truth

agent

(noun). Người đại diện

ex: in the event of illness, a durable power of attorney enabled her nephew to act as her agent

deploy

(verb). vào hàng ngũ

ex: forces were deployed at strategic locations

grammatical

(adjective). ngữ pháp

ex: it contains a few grammatical errors

category

(noun). thể loại, phạm trù, hạng mục

ex: The cars belong to the same category

patient

(noun). Bệnh nhân

ex: many patients in the hospital were more ill than she was

reference

(noun). Dẫn chứng

ex: he made reference to the enormous power of the mass media

justification

(noun). sự biện minh

ex: there is no justification for an increase in charges

chronic

(adjective). Mãn tính

ex: the school suffers from chronic overcrowding

infection

(noun). sự nhiễm trùng

ex: strict hygiene will limit the risk of infection

potentially

(adverb). Có triển vọng

ex: newly available oil might potentially create a drop in prices

previously

(adverb). trước đó

ex: they discovered a previously unknown gene

convincing

(adjective). thuyết phục

ex: the team cruised to a convincing win

reject

(verb). Từ chối, bác bỏ

ex: his body could begin to reject the implanted heart

summarize

(verb). Tóm tắt lại

ex: these results can be summarized in the following table

persuasively

(adverb). một cách thuyết phục

ex: they persuasively argue that the previously unknown temple was dedicated to the worship of a local fertility deity

direct

(adjective). Trực diện

ex: She decided to take direct control of the project.

progress

(noun). tiến triển

ex: the darkness did not stop my progress

cognitive

(adjective). Liên quan đến nhận thức

ex: the cognitive processes involved in reading

outline

(verb). Vẽ phác, phác thảo

ex: The area we're interested in is outlined in red on the map.

opposing

(adjective). đối lập nhau

ex: the brothers fought on opposing sides in the war

concerning

(preposition). liên quan

ex: My mom used to tell me dreadful stories concerning a horrible beast

several

(pronoun). nhiều

ex:She's the author of several books

syllable

(noun). Âm tiết

ex: I'd never have breathed a syllable if he'd kept quiet

vowel

(noun). Phụ âm

ex: A short vowel is a short sound as in the word "cup".

consonant

(noun). Nguyên âm

ex: She's got some unpronounceable name that seems to be all consonants.

territory

(noun). Lãnh thổ

ex: From now on the kitchen was her territory

readily

(adverb). sẵn sàng

ex: she readily agreed to do it

recursion

(noun). Sự quay trở lại, Sự đệ quy

ex: The function can be solved by recursion.

infinitely

(adverb). vô hạn

ex: there are issues here that could be expanded infinitely

essential

(adjective). thiết yếu

ex: it is essential to keep up-to-date records

communications

(noun). thông tin liên lạc

ex: a city providing excellent road and rail communications

interpret

(verb). Diễn giải

ex: the evidence is difficult to interpret

underlying

(adjective). cơ bản

ex: underlying problems need to be addressed

obey

(verb). Tuân lệnh

ex: the officer was convicted for refusing to obey orders

outlier

(noun). ngoại lai, ngoại lệ

ex: Five of seven outliers had substantial salary increases in their last five years

trait

(noun). đặc điểm

ex: he was a letter-of-the-law man, a common trait among coaches

display

(verb). Trưng bày

ex: pressing the F1 key will display a help screen

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

ex: this will set the pattern for the weeks ahead

idiosyncrasy

(noun). tính chất riêng

ex: one of his little idiosyncrasies was always preferring to be in the car first

widespread

(adjective). phổ biến rộng rãi

ex: there was widespread support for the war

enthusiasm

(noun). Sự hăng hái

ex: they did it with little enthusiasm

finding

(noun). Phát hiện, thông tin tìm được

ex: a local doctor reported the finding of numerous dead rats

straitjacket

(noun). Áo bó

ex: Brody was locked in a padded cell and forced to wear a straitjacket.

coffin

(noun). Quan tài

ex: they lowered her coffin into the ground

Institute

(verb). ban hành

ex: the award was instituted in 1900

Evolutionary

(adjective). tiến triển

ex: he was in command of the evolutionary squadron

Anthropology

(noun). Nhân chủng học.

ex: At least three aspects of philosophical anthropology have been of chief interest to philosophers of religion.

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

ex: Her critics say she is leading the party to disaster.
